Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: After authoritative confirmation was already in view (Stanford Law and Britannica via the SERP), the Planner entered a verification loop and kept instructing WebSurfer to run near-duplicate searches and reopen the same sources instead of synthesizing the gathered facts into a final answer. This over-reliance on repeated retrieval, without transitioning to extraction and synthesis, stalled progress and risked an incomplete or incorrect resolution rather than delivering the straightforward answer (Stanford University/Stanford Law School, Stanford, California).
